set -a; source .run-env; set +a
# Create a confirmed booking
F=$(curl -s -X POST $EDGE_URL/flights -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"seatCount":4,"seatPrice":700}')
FID=$(echo $F | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])')
C=$(curl -s -X POST $EDGE_URL/customers -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"name":"persist","balance":5000}')
CID=$(echo $C | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])')
BID=$(python3 -c 'import uuid;print(uuid.uuid4())')
curl -s -X POST $EDGE_URL/bookings -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"bookingId\":\"$BID\",\"customerId\":\"$CID\",\"flightId\":\"$FID\",\"seat\":\"1A\"}" >/dev/null
sleep 2
echo "BEFORE restart:"
echo "  booking: $(curl -s $EDGE_URL/bookings/$BID)"
echo "  balance: $(curl -s $EDGE_URL/customers/$CID | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["balance"])')"
echo "  stats:   $(curl -s $EDGE_URL/stats/bookings)"
# Restart all services
for svc in flights bookings payments edge; do ./scripts/restart-service.sh $svc >/dev/null 2>&1; done
sleep 2
echo "AFTER restart:"
echo "  booking: $(curl -s $EDGE_URL/bookings/$BID)"
echo "  balance: $(curl -s $EDGE_URL/customers/$CID | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["balance"])')"
echo "  seat1A:  $(curl -s $EDGE_URL/flights/$FID | python3 -c 'import sys,json;[print(s) for s in json.load(sys.stdin)["seats"] if s["seat"]=="1A"]')"
echo "  stats:   $(curl -s $EDGE_URL/stats/bookings)"
echo "  notifs:  $(curl -s $EDGE_URL/customers/$CID/notifications)"
